visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a neutrally lit living room, a man in a black-and-white vertical striped shirt and a woman in a white tube top and denim skirt sit on a grey sofa. The woman gestures while speaking. (2) The man uses his hand to gather the woman's hair into a bunch, preparing to tie it. (3) A series of rapid visual cuts show the man and woman moving through various rooms including a bathroom, kitchen, and hallway. In every cut, the man is physically holding the woman's hair bunch as they search the environment. The man's expression is focused and frantic. (4) They appear in a modern elevator lobby with marble walls. The woman expresses frustration through facial expressions and hand gestures, eventually pulling her hair away and walking off-screen. The man remains static, looking puzzled. (5) The screen cuts to solid black with large red text centered on the frame.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Request -> Frantic Obsessive Search -> Conflict -> Unresolved Ending.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic skit that hyperbolizes a simple request—finding a rubber band to tie hair—into an obsessive and chaotic search. The humor stems from the man dragging the woman around by her hair through various rooms while yelling the same question, and the eventual anti-climactic frustration of the woman.
